title: The spectrum of a finite free algebra is finite locally free
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $S$ a commutative $A$-algebra admitting an $A$-module basis indexed by a finite set (the empty set is allowed) [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Then the structural morphism $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free], meaning finite, flat and locally of finite presentation. No Noetherian or nonzero-ring hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 02KB, label lemma-finite-flat, proof of (1) implies (2), affine finite free case

proof.text: Write the given finite basis as $(e_i)_{i\in I}$. Every element of $S$ is an $A$-linear combination of these finitely many elements, so $S$ is a finitely generated $A$-module by [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-spec-finite-ring-map-finite] to the structural ring map $A\to S$. Its induced scheme morphism $f:\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is finite.

source.place: Tag 02KB, label lemma-finite-flat, proof of (1) implies (2), affine finite free case

proof.text: The given basis makes $S$ free over $A$. The last clause of [lem-weil-pbc-projective-module-flat] says every free module is flat, hence $A\to S$ is a flat ring map. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-iff-flat-affine] to this very structural map: $f$ is flat.

source.place: Tag 02KB, label lemma-finite-flat, proof of (1) implies (2), affine finite free case

proof.text: Expand $1_S=\sum_i u_i e_i$ and $e_i e_j=\sum_k c_{ij}^k e_k$ in the basis, with coefficients in $A$. Form the $A$-algebra $Q=A[(T_i)_{i\in I}]/J$, where $J$ is generated by $1-\sum_i u_iT_i$ and all $T_iT_j-\sum_k c_{ij}^kT_k$. Choose a bijection $I\cong\{1,\ldots,n\}$ with $n=|I|$ (also for $n=0$). Relabelling along this bijection gives precisely the finite-variable polynomial ring of [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], with $1+n^2$ relations. Evaluation $T_i\mapsto e_i$ kills these relations and defines an $A$-algebra map $q:Q\to S$.

source.place: Tag 0D46, label lemma-finite-finite-type, proof of (2), specialized to a finite basis (no linear relations)

proof.text: For $s=\sum_i a_i e_i$, set $v(s)=\sum_i a_i\overline T_i$ in $Q$. Uniqueness of basis coordinates makes $v$ well-defined: the coordinates of $s+t$ are the coordinatewise sums, and those of $as$ are $a$ times the coordinates of $s$. Thus $v$ is additive and $A$-linear. The unit relation gives $v(1_S)=1_Q$. For $s=\sum_i a_i e_i$ and $t=\sum_j b_j e_j$, the multiplication relations give $v(s)v(t)=\sum_{i,j,k}a_ib_jc_{ij}^k\overline T_k=v(st)$, Moreover $v(a1_S)=av(1_S)=a1_Q$, so $v$ is an $A$-algebra map. Now $qv(s)=\sum_i a_ie_i=s$, and $vq$ fixes all coefficients and all $\overline T_i$, hence fixes every polynomial class. Thus $q$ and $v$ are inverse. This is a finite algebra presentation of $S$ in the precise sense of [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. If $I$ is empty, the basis forces $S=0$ and the unit relation is $1=0$, so $Q=A/(1)=0$ and the same maps are inverse. This also covers $A=0$ without requiring uniqueness of the cardinality of a basis.

source.place: Tag 0D46, label lemma-finite-finite-type, proof of (2), specialized to a finite basis (no linear relations)

proof.text: For each point of $\operatorname{Spec}S$, choose the whole affine source and whole affine target as the neighbourhoods in [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Their ring map $A\to S$ has the finite presentation just constructed, so $f$ is locally of finite presentation. If the source has no points, this condition is vacuous. Together with finiteness and flatness from steps 1 and 2, this is exactly finite local freeness as defined in [def-pc-finite-locally-free].

mathlib_candidate.why: The three SpecMap criteria give the three morphism properties. Module.Flat.of_free (RingTheory/Flat/Basic.lean:231) and Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finitePresentation (RingTheory/Finiteness/ModuleFinitePresentation.lean:70-76) are instances, but Module.finitePresentation_of_projective (Algebra/Module/FinitePresentation.lean:161-165) is explicitly not an instance. Finite module freeness must first supply module finite presentation using this non-instance theorem; hence this is not one criterion per clause with inferred hypotheses. The flat affine criterion is HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (Morphisms/RingHomProperties.lean:360-364), specialized using the Flat HasRingHomProperty instance (Morphisms/Flat.lean:53-57); this is the source-verified reference.
